The '''1984–85 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], seven points ahead of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Dumbarton F.C.|Dumbarton]] and [[Greenock Morton F.C.|Morton]] were relegated. As of 2026, this is the last season that a team other than [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] or Celtic has won the top level of Scottish football; it also marked a third consecutive year that a team other than them won the Scottish title, the only time this has ever happened.
